title: Understanding PCA
text: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to emphasize variation and bring out strong patterns in a dataset. It helps in reducing the dimensionality of the data while preserving as much variance as possible. Think about how PCA might transform your data and what it means for the variance.

title: Scree Plot Insights
text: A scree plot is a useful tool in PCA. It shows the proportion of total variance captured by each principal component. Consider how the shape of the scree plot might help you decide how many components to keep.

title: Evaluating Statements about PCA
text: Which of the following statements is true about PCA?
choices: PCA increases the number of dimensions in the data
PCA is a supervised learning technique
PCA is used to classify data into categories
PCA reduces dimensionality by preserving variance
